en.title: Changelog
en.subtitle: Stay updated with the latest features, improvements, and fixes in TutorNote

cta.title: Ready to Explore?
cta.description: Try out the new interactive examples module with step-by-step solutions and dynamic diagrams

en.footer: Built with ❤️ for Hong Kong DSE students

v2.3.1.title: 🎨 Improved Key Concept Layout & Display
v2.3.1.description: Enhanced layout for key concept displays with better two-column arrangement and improved mobile responsiveness

features.title: Two-Column Key Concept Layout
features.description: Key concept highlight component now displays in a clean two-column layout (concept statement and formulas on left, derivations and notes on right) for better readability

features.title: Side-by-Side Concept Cards
features.description: Key concept excerpt cards on question detail pages now display side by side in a single row, showing up to 2 cards simultaneously for better space utilization

features.title: Enhanced Mobile Responsiveness
features.description: All key concept components now adapt seamlessly to mobile devices, stacking vertically on small screens and displaying in columns on larger screens

features.title: Improved Visual Hierarchy
features.description: Better organization of key concept information with clearer separation between different sections (formulas, derivations, supplementary notes)

v2.3.0.title: 📚 Interactive Examples Module & Enhanced Notes
v2.3.0.description: Revolutionary interactive examples system with step-by-step solutions, dynamic diagrams, and continuously expanding note library

features.title: Interactive Examples Module
features.description: Complete interactive examples system with key concepts, step-by-step solutions, and GeoGebra diagrams

features.title: Continuously Expanding Content
features.description: Notes augmented with examples are continuously being added to provide comprehensive learning materials

features.title: Mobile-Optimized Rendering
features.description: Fully responsive design with mobile-first approach - optimized typography, spacing, and scrollable content for all devices

features.title: Dynamic URL System
features.description: Direct access to examples via clean URLs like /quadratic-equations-in-one-unknown/real-roots

features.title: Enhanced Math Rendering
features.description: Improved KaTeX rendering with proper handling of line breaks and escaped characters in problem statements

features.title: Improved Functionality
features.description: Various functionality improvements across the platform for better user experience and performance

v2.2.0.title: 🌐 Bilingual Tag Translation & Enhanced Search
v2.2.0.description: Revolutionary translation system that automatically translates search tags between English and Chinese, plus major improvements to search functionality

features.title: Bidirectional Tag Translation
features.description: Search tags automatically translate when switching languages - English tags become Chinese and vice versa

features.title: Smart Pagination with Tag Preservation
features.description: Fixed pagination to preserve search tags in URLs - no more losing your search when clicking page 2

features.title: Enhanced Search Field Experience
features.description: Eliminated flickering and disappearing text in the tag search field for smooth tag selection

features.title: Improved Tag Selection Display
features.description: Selected tags now display properly in the search box with automatic focus management

features.title: Robust URL Parameter Handling
features.description: Enhanced URL parsing to handle both single tags with spaces and comma-separated multiple tags

v2.1.5.title: Redux Integration & Build Optimization
v2.1.5.description: Successfully merged Redux state management and resolved all build issues for smooth deployment

features.title: Redux State Management
features.description: Integrated Redux Toolkit for centralized state management across the application

features.title: Build Process Optimization
features.description: Fixed all ESLint warnings and build errors to ensure successful Netlify deployment

features.title: Code Quality Improvements
features.description: Cleaned up unused imports and functions for better maintainability and performance

features.title: Deployment Ready
features.description: Application now builds successfully without warnings, ready for production deployment

v2.1.4.title: Robust Back Button for Tag Search Navigation
v2.1.4.description: Fixed navigation issue where users couldn't return to tag search results after clicking on specific questions

features.title: Smart Back Button Detection
features.description: Back button now appears when navigating from tag search results to question pages, showing the correct search context

features.title: Triple-Layer Navigation State
features.description: Uses URL parameters, sessionStorage, and document referrer for reliable navigation state detection

features.title: Enhanced User Experience
features.description: Users can now easily return to their original tag search results with a single click

features.title: Robust State Management
features.description: Navigation state is embedded in URLs and automatically cleaned up to prevent conflicts

v2.1.3.title: Enhanced Question Navigation
v2.1.3.description: Improved navigation between DSE Math questions with larger, more intuitive controls and better visual design

features.title: Sequential Question Navigation
features.description: Navigate through questions in logical order: earlier years → later years, Paper I → Paper II, ascending question numbers

features.title: Smart Question Skipping
features.description: Automatically skips missing questions (e.g., if Q6 doesn't exist, goes to Q30) for seamless navigation

features.title: Enhanced Visual Design
features.description: Larger navigation arrows with professional styling, smooth hover effects, and better integration with the UI

features.title: Intelligent Tooltips
features.description: Hover over navigation buttons to see exactly which question you'll navigate to next

v2.1.2.title: Smarter Search Experience
v2.1.2.description: Made searching for math questions more intuitive and reliable with better navigation and cleaner interface

features.title: No More Confusing URLs
features.description: When you click on topic tags, you'll always land on the right search page instead of getting stuck on weird mixed URLs

features.title: One Search Method at a Time
features.description: The system now automatically clears conflicting search options - no more accidentally mixing year filters with topic tags

features.title: Faster Page Loading
features.description: Improved backend performance means search results load quicker, especially when browsing through multiple pages

features.title: Cleaner Mobile Experience
features.description: Search interface is now more streamlined on phones and tablets, making it easier to find questions on the go

v2.1.1.title: Popular Tags Count Fix
v2.1.1.description: Fixed inaccurate tag counts in the popular tags section

features.title: Accurate Tag Counts
features.description: Popular tags now show correct counts from the entire database instead of just the first 100 questions

features.title: Improved Data Accuracy
features.description: Tag popularity statistics now reflect the true distribution across all questions

v2.1.0.title: Direct Question URL System
v2.1.0.description: Revolutionary URL system for direct question access and seamless navigation

features.title: Direct Question URLs
features.description: Access any question directly via URLs like /DSE_Math/2023/I/15

features.title: Smart Search Integration
features.description: Search functionality works perfectly from any direct question URL

features.title: Intelligent Navigation
features.description: Seamless navigation between questions with proper URL updates

features.title: Performance Optimized
features.description: Fixed infinite loop issues and optimized rendering performance

features.title: Mobile Responsive
features.description: Fully responsive design that works perfectly on all devices

v2.0.0.title: Enhanced User Experience
v2.0.0.description: Major improvements to user interface and functionality

features.title: Improved Question Display
features.description: Better formatting and readability for math questions

features.title: Bug Fixes
features.description: Resolved various UI and functionality issues

zh.footer: 用 ❤️ 為香港DSE學生打造

v2.3.1.title: 🎨 改進的核心概念佈局與顯示
v2.3.1.description: 增強核心概念顯示的佈局，採用更好的兩欄排列和改進的手機響應式設計

features.title: 兩欄核心概念佈局
features.description: 核心概念高亮組件現在以清晰的兩欄佈局顯示（左側為概念陳述和公式，右側為推導和備註），提升可讀性

features.title: 並排概念卡片
features.description: 問題詳情頁面上的核心概念摘要卡片現在並排顯示在同一行，最多同時顯示2張卡片，更好地利用空間

features.title: 增強的手機響應式設計
features.description: 所有核心概念組件現在都能無縫適應手機設備，在小屏幕上垂直堆疊，在較大屏幕上以欄位顯示

features.title: 改進的視覺層次
features.description: 更好地組織核心概念信息，更清晰地區分不同部分（公式、推導、補充備註）

v2.3.0.title: 📚 互動範例模組與增強筆記
v2.3.0.description: 革命性的互動範例系統，包含逐步解答、動態圖表，以及持續擴展的筆記庫

features.title: 互動範例模組
features.description: 完整的互動範例系統，包含核心概念、逐步解答和 GeoGebra 圖表

features.title: 持續擴展內容
features.description: 附有範例的筆記持續新增，提供全面的學習材料

features.title: 手機優化渲染
features.description: 完全響應式設計，採用手機優先方法 - 優化字體、間距和可滾動內容，適用於所有設備

features.title: 動態URL系統
features.description: 通過簡潔的URL（如 /quadratic-equations-in-one-unknown/real-roots）直接存取範例

features.title: 增強的數學渲染
features.description: 改進的 KaTeX 渲染，正確處理問題陳述中的換行和轉義字符

features.title: 功能改進
features.description: 平台上各種功能的改進，提升用戶體驗和性能

v2.2.0.title: 🌐 雙語標籤翻譯與增強搜尋
v2.2.0.description: 革命性的翻譯系統，自動在英文和中文之間翻譯搜尋標籤，並大幅改進搜尋功能

features.title: 雙向標籤翻譯
features.description: 切換語言時搜尋標籤自動翻譯 - 英文標籤變為中文，反之亦然

features.title: 智能分頁與標籤保留
features.description: 修復分頁功能，在URL中保留搜尋標籤 - 點擊第2頁時不會再丟失搜尋條件

features.title: 增強的搜尋欄體驗
features.description: 消除標籤搜尋欄中的閃爍和消失文字，實現流暢的標籤選擇

features.title: 改進的標籤選擇顯示
features.description: 選中的標籤現在在搜尋框中正確顯示，並具有自動焦點管理

features.title: 強健的URL參數處理
features.description: 增強的URL解析，可處理帶空格的單個標籤和逗號分隔的多個標籤

v2.1.5.title: Redux 整合與構建優化
v2.1.5.description: 成功合併 Redux 狀態管理並解決所有構建問題，實現順暢部署

features.title: Redux 狀態管理
features.description: 整合 Redux Toolkit，實現應用程式的集中式狀態管理

features.title: 構建過程優化
features.description: 修復所有 ESLint 警告和構建錯誤，確保成功的 Netlify 部署

features.title: 代碼質量改進
features.description: 清理未使用的導入和函數，提升可維護性和性能

features.title: 部署就緒
features.description: 應用程式現在可以在沒有警告的情況下成功構建，準備生產部署

v2.1.4.title: 強健的標籤搜尋導航返回按鈕
v2.1.4.description: 修復導航問題，用戶在點擊特定問題後無法返回標籤搜尋結果

features.title: 智能返回按鈕檢測
features.description: 從標籤搜尋結果導航到問題頁面時，返回按鈕現在會顯示，顯示正確的搜尋上下文

features.title: 三層導航狀態
features.description: 使用URL參數、sessionStorage 和文檔引用器進行可靠的導航狀態檢測

features.title: 增強的用戶體驗
features.description: 用戶現在只需單擊即可輕鬆返回原始標籤搜尋結果

features.title: 強健的狀態管理
features.description: 導航狀態嵌入在URL中，並自動清理以防止衝突

v2.1.3.title: 增強的問題導航
v2.1.3.description: 改進DSE數學問題之間的導航，具有更大、更直觀的控制和更好的視覺設計

features.title: 順序問題導航
features.description: 以邏輯順序瀏覽問題：較早年份 → 較晚年份，試卷一 → 試卷二，遞增問題編號

features.title: 智能問題跳過
features.description: 自動跳過缺失的問題（例如，如果Q6不存在，則轉到Q30）以實現無縫導航

features.title: 增強的視覺設計
features.description: 更大的導航箭頭，具有專業樣式、平滑懸停效果和更好的UI整合

features.title: 智能工具提示
features.description: 懸停在導航按鈕上可看到您將導航到的確切問題

v2.1.2.title: 更智能的搜尋體驗
v2.1.2.description: 通過更好的導航和更清潔的界面，使數學問題搜尋更加直觀和可靠

features.title: 不再有混淆的URL
features.description: 當您點擊主題標籤時，您總是會登陸正確的搜尋頁面，而不會卡在奇怪的混合URL上

features.title: 一次使用一種搜尋方法
features.description: 系統現在自動清除衝突的搜尋選項 - 不再意外混合年份過濾器和主題標籤

features.title: 更快的頁面加載
features.description: 改進的後端性能意味著搜尋結果加載更快，特別是在瀏覽多個頁面時

features.title: 更清潔的手機體驗
features.description: 搜尋界面現在在手機和平板上更加精簡，使在旅途中查找問題更容易

v2.1.1.title: 熱門標籤計數修復
v2.1.1.description: 修復了熱門標籤部分中不準確的標籤計數

features.title: 準確的標籤計數
features.description: 熱門標籤現在顯示整個數據庫的正確計數，而不僅僅是前100個問題

features.title: 改進的數據準確性
features.description: 標籤流行度統計現在反映所有問題的真實分佈

v2.1.0.title: 直接問題URL系統
v2.1.0.description: 革命性的URL系統，用於直接問題訪問和無縫導航

features.description: 通過URL（如 /DSE_Math/2023/I/15）直接訪問任何問題

features.title: 智能搜尋整合
features.description: 搜尋功能從任何直接問題URL完美運行

features.title: 智能導航
features.description: 問題之間的無縫導航，具有正確的URL更新

features.title: 性能優化
features.description: 修復了無限循環問題並優化了渲染性能

features.title: 手機響應式
features.description: 完全響應式設計，在所有設備上完美運行
